_README: DMV (DC / Maryland / Virginia) high school basketball prospects. SAMPLE/PLACEHOLDER records — fictional names and data to demonstrate the schema. Replace with real prospects. Keyed list; `id` is a lowercase-alphanumeric slug of the name.

_schema.id: lowercase-alphanumeric slug of name (join key, matches prospectFilm.json)
_schema.name: Full name
_schema.position: PG | SG | SF | PF | C (combos allowed, e.g. 'PG/SG')
_schema.stars: Recruiting star rating 3-5 (number, null if unrated)
_schema.rankings: { national, position, state } — composite ranks (null where unknown)
_schema.offers: Array of college names with offers out
_schema.traits: Array of { name, grade (1-10), note } — scout grades
_schema.stats: { ppg, rpg, apg, spg, bpg, fgPct, threePct, ftPct } — season averages
